earnings.title: November 18, 2026
highlights: (NYSE: LOW) today reported net earnings of $1.7 billion and diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $2.98 for the quarter ended October 30, 2026, compared to diluted EPS of $2.88 in the third quarter of 2025.
Excluding these expenses, third quarte r 2026 adju sted diluted EPS 1 increased 1.3% to $3.10 compared to the prior-year adjusted diluted EPS.
Both diluted EPS and adjusted diluted EPS 1 include a $0.34 positive impact from IEEPA tariff refunds.
Total sales for the quarter were $22.8 billion, compared to $20.8 billion in the prior-year quarter.
Comparable sales for the quarter increased 1.8%, driven by a 17.4% increase in online sales as well as solid performance in Pro and home services sales.
outlook: Comparable sales expected to be up approximately +0.5% compared to prior year (previously flat)
